svg.title: Import people from a CSV — SoftTrack web design mockup (#305)
svg.desc: An organisation that adopts SoftTrack has its people in a spreadsheet, with their departments, managers and start dates, and all of it is typed in again a person at a time. A CSV is uploaded and run dry first, reporting row by row what would be created, changed and what is wrong; then applied; matched on email, so running the same file twice changes nothing.
svg.text: A dry run that changes nothing
